scope: shared-export two-library build and runtime review

findings.issue: CLI and JNI could enter process-global model state concurrently
findings.fix: Shared session lease across C entry points and Runner lifetime; permits closing on another thread

findings.issue: MOE_BUILD_NATIVE=0 could relabel DSP and RPC artifacts for a different ISA, SDK or profiling configuration
findings.fix: Native provenance and artifact hashes checked before configuring ARM and JNI builds

findings.issue: TARGET.json was published before ARM compilation succeeded
findings.fix: Invalidate incomplete build metadata; serialize build writes and atomically publish successful paired-library hashes

findings.issue: Changes to the linker export map did not trigger relinking
findings.fix: LINK_DEPENDS tracks infer.exports; export cache also tracks CMake validation scripts

findings.issue: Public inference header was invalid C and C entry points accepted null argv
findings.fix: Guard C++ linkage, validate arguments and return errors across the C boundary

findings.issue: C entry point --help terminated the host process
findings.fix: Return a help_requested option and complete the entry call normally

findings.issue: C entry point left stdout and stderr redirected after returning
findings.fix: Reuse ScopedConsoleOutput to restore original descriptors on normal and exceptional return

notes: This review ran focused regressions, not the full performance or PPL matrix.
Earlier performance results belong to the binaries and hashes in the earlier validation report.
Shared export is a system prerequisite; non-shared PTE support is outside scope and was not classified as a bug.

follow_up_entry_review.scope: shared export and its public C entry points
